decision_rationale: Both canonical and superseded candidate roots were absent before the namespace was created. The admitted SSHFS root passed deterministic small-file and 64 MiB direct-write close/fsync/reopen/hash/rename tests; directory fsync and no-replace rename collision detection were also supported. Every fixture was removed.
